newsitem.title: USA: Granite stake lifted by Kramer Spellman.
newsitem.headline: Granite stake lifted by Kramer Spellman.

text.p: A group including Kramer Spellman L.P. said Friday it raised its stake in Granite Financial Inc to 10.95 percent or 408,000 common shares .

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York-based investment group said it bought 60,000 additional shares of Granite between December 4 and 12 at pricesr anging from $8.875 to $9.25 a share.
The group previously held a 9.34 percent stake in the Westminster, Colo.,-based equipment lease financing company.
